note: vs_density is reciprocity / density, the ratio the page already quotes: 1.0 is what a directed Erdos-Renyi graph at the same density gives for free. null is 100 directed, degree-preserving rewirings of the same graph (three-edge swaps; every country's in- and out-degree held fixed) and z is how many of the null's own standard deviations the real reciprocity sits above its mean, the same kind of baseline week03_country_networks.py already reports for clustering, assortativity, mean path and diameter.
